t: Do Your Buses Get Stuck in Traffic? (The Downs-Thomson Paradox)

q.x: The less you invest in public transportation, the more people will drive. The more people that drive, the slower traffic gets. If you just widen the road, all you do is increase the amount of cars that drive.

recs.stt: Amtrak might add more routes, but they won't be faster than a car
recs.x: Train fans will always still take the train, and for good reason (they are a better experience in some ways), but the fundamental issue of whether we can address car traffic and congestion is about whether other forms of transit can be faster. [link] and [link] are great overviews
